claims.value: The mapped region represents much of mainland China and Hainan during a period of divided republican authority. In July 1920, the Peking government faced rival military factions, provincial governors controlled much of their troops and revenue, and a separate military government operated at Canton.

scope.description: Composite map region, not one historical state or a single warlord clique. Separately mapped Manchuria, Xinjiang and Tibet and omitted Taiwan must remain outside this feature’s facts.
